edits.prompt:
Handmade layered paper-collage illustration matching the attached approved paper references.
Every shape is cut from thick matte coloured paper with slightly uneven hand-torn edges,
visible paper fibres, subtle grain and occasional thin pale torn-fibre rims.
Build anatomy, muscles, hair and clothing folds from overlapping paper pieces.
Use restrained flat paper colours with small tonal variations and soft short shadows
between layers. Match the reference lighting, paper texture scale and level of detail.
Expressive stylized faces and athletic semi-realistic proportions, as in the character sheets.
No continuous black body outlines; separate forms with paper edges and layer shadows.
Palette: warm cream, kraft tan, dusty blue, mustard yellow, warm gray and navy.
No glossy surfaces, photorealism, 3D rendering, watercolor, pencil hatching or pixel art.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, diagrams,
motion lines, impact stars or editorial effects.
No blood, wounds, bruises, broken teeth or weapons.
TASK: update an existing finished paper-collage picture with the user's approved new Gromila likeness. Output a single PNG, exactly 1536x1024.
Edit reference image 1. Preserve its pose, camera, composition, positions, clothing, props, ring, paper background, empty title zone and lighting. Only Gromila's face, hair/beard, skin tone and body shape are being replaced.
Reference image 2 is the accepted NEW Gromila sheet: the three views show ONE man, not three people. It OVERRIDES the old bald, dark-bearded character visible in the scene.
NEW GROMILA: the same recognizable man as reference 2, high rounded forehead, very receding hairline with sparse short light-brown hair at temples/back, light-blue eyes, natural light eyebrows, a broad rounded face and nose, dense light-brown/dark-blond full beard with lighter ends. Light beige skin. Extremely thick muscular neck, rounded huge shoulders and upper arms, thick forearms, massive broad chest and a thick strong waist. Same gray tank, navy sweatpants, bare feet and bare fists. Preserve the source's scale and pose while adapting its physique. Copy the proposed sheet's recognizable face, rather than inventing another man.
Draw his features as paper layers and restrained ink, consistent with the accepted sheet. Do not paste a photographic face. No black pointed beard, completely bald head, exaggerated black angry V-shaped brows, shiny skin or photographic background.
Where Tetsu appears, retain him exactly: same face, black undercut, healed eyebrow detail, mustard shorts, red hand wraps, pose and proportions. Do not change him to resemble Gromila.
Other attached scene references show material, palette and light ONLY; do not copy their other people, poses or composition. Preserve the source's blank title area and the existing central 16:9 safe crop y=80..943. No text or new effects.
Reference image 3 is Tetsu's unchanged accepted sheet. Reference image 4 is the user's accepted new-Gromila flex scene, used for material and likeness continuity.
Exactly TWO people: Tetsu on the left and Gromila on the right, with the same approved straightened attacking left arm and the visible small gap between the red fist and the chin. Do not bend the attacking arm into another punch and do not move the fist or head. Gromila's head remains slightly turned, looking toward the opponent, calm/surprised rather than wounded. Keep both figures fully inside the frame. Red only on Tetsu's wraps.
Match the paper style, colours and lighting of the attached scene picture.
